A forced first crossing of the middle letter makes each small-large pair reverse twice, giving sharp lower bound 2hℓ+h+ℓ. The unique odd diametral pair follows from the two max-inversion permutations. Independent full BFS on all 321-avoiders for n=1..6 reproduces 0,1,4,7,12,17 and odd uniqueness.
